    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "LUCANIAN SAUSAGE [or meat pudding] ARE MADE SIMILAR TO THE ABOVE: CRUSH {{ing_01|PEPPER}}, {{ing_02|CUMIN}}, {{ing_03|SAVORY}}, {{ing_04|RUE}}, {{ing_05|PARSLEY}}, {{ing_06|CONDIMENT}}, {{ing_07|LAUREL BERRIES}} AND {{ing_08|BROTH}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "MIX WITH {{ing_09|FINELY CHOPPED [fresh Pork]}} AND POUND WELL WITH {{ing_08|BROTH}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "TO THIS MIXTURE, BEING RICH, ADD {{ing_10|WHOLE PEPPER}} AND {{ing_11|NUTS}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "WHEN FILLING {{ing_12|CASINGS}} CAREFULLY PUSH THE MEAT THROUGH."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "HANG SAUSAGE UP TO SMOKE."
    }
